create_shm_ring_buffer: create a single-writer multi-reader shared memory ring buffer with a given size and name
allocate_shm_buffer: allocate a buffer chunk in the shared memory ring buffer and return its address and monotonic id
free_shm_buffer: free buffers in the ring buffer when readers are done, returning freed monotonic ids
put_object_storage: put a key-value pair into the shared memory object storage with automatic FIFO eviction
get_object_storage: get a deserialized object from the shared memory object storage by address and monotonic id
